Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability exploitation via preview methods allowing unauthenticated users to insert and execute malicious payloads
Impacted Systems: Magento Commerce 2.3.2 (if security-only patch 2.3.2-p2 not installed)
Unsupported versions of Page Builder (e.g., Page Builder Beta)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of RCE vulnerability in preview methods
